content:
mira: heads-up — prepping RC cut for 1.8 in ~2h. a couple PRs need backports + changelog. can someone take a look?

alex: on it, reviewing PR #4123 (model-serve/cold-start fix): https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123
alex: quick q — does this need a changelog blurb or is it internal?

mira: yes, add under "Bug fixes" -> Runtime. short line: "Fix cold start for model routing (service)". keep it concise.

sam: i can do the backport to release/v1.8 once it's merged. ping me after lgtm.

release-bot: cut window opens at 16:00 UTC. outstanding: 4123 (needs LGTM), 4132 (changelog), 4137 (backport conflict)

alex: left a few small nits, nothing blocking. pushed a tiny follow-up.

zach: LGTM on 4123 — tested locally, no perf change. :thumbsup:

mira: thanks @zach. @sam can you queue the backport and run the smoke? include the cherry-pick SHA in the PR description.

sam: will do. cherry-pick commands i'll run:
```
git checkout release/v1.8
git fetch origin
git cherry-pick -x abcdef1234567890
git push origin HEAD:release/v1.8-backport/4123
```
I'll open the backport PR and add `changelog: Fix cold start for model routing (runtime)` in the changelog entry.

mira: perfect. if anything blocks, call it out here — otherwise we'll include 4123 in the RC.

alex: one more note — tagging the PR with `backport/1.8` and `changelog-needed` helps release-bot pick it up.

sam: tagged and opened backport PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4189

release-bot: backport PR 4189 queued for CI. smoke tests scheduled.

mira: great work — tracking these in the release checklist. thanks all.
